question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        cu.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY cu.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q2019.cust_city
    FROM city_sales q2019
    JOIN city_sales q2020 ON q2019.cust_city = q2020.cust_city
    WHERE q2019.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND q2020.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND (q2020.total_sales - q2019.total_sales) * 100.0 / q2019.total_sales >= 20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND cu.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_quarter_id,
        SUM(prod_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        pqs.prod_id,
        pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
        pqs.prod_sales,
        qt.total_sales,
        pqs.prod_sales * 100.0 / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(prod_sales) as total_prod_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top20 AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_totals
    QUALIFY NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_prod_sales DESC) = 1
),
share_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.prod_id,
        s2019.share as share_2019q4,
        s2020.share as share_2020q4,
        s2020.share - s2019.share as pp_change
    FROM product_shares s2019
    JOIN product_shares s2020 ON s2019.prod_id = s2020.prod_id
    WHERE s2019.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
      AND s2020.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
      AND s2019.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top20)
)
SELECT 
    sc.prod_id,
    p.prod_name,
    sc.pp_change,
    sc.share_2019q4,
    sc.share_2020q4
FROM share_changes sc
JOIN products p ON sc.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY ABS(sc.pp_change) ASC
LIMIT 1
